item.title: Arkansas murder suspect wins Republican primary for county sheriff race
item.description: Aaron Spencer won the Republican primary for Lonoke County sheriff, receiving 5,400 votes, and will face Democrat Brian Mitchell Sr. in the November general election, although Spencer is currently awaiting trial on a second-degree murder charge.

item.title: Kansas City Chiefs to trade Trent McDuffie to Los Angeles Rams: report
item.description: The Kansas City Chiefs and Los Angeles Rams working on a trade for Trent McDuffie in exchange for the 29th pick in the 2026 NFL Draft

item.title: Severe Thunderstorm Watch issued
item.description: A Severe T-Storm Watch has been issued for areas near and south of a Branson to Winona line through 9 pm, with the potential for golf ball-sized hail, damaging wind gusts, a limited tornado threat, and heavy rainfall that could lead to localized flooding.

item.title: This week's Springfield historical headlines: 1926 & 1976, Mar. 1-7
item.description: The History Museum on the Square and Sharing Stories of the Crossroads has preserved news articles from a century ago, including headlines from 1926 and 1976, such as the Bell Telephone Company's record gain in new phone customers, the Frisco's track raising for passenger trains, and the National Endowment for the Humanities' funding of a new class at SMS called Ozark Studies One.

item.title: Storms pushing through tonight, another overnight storm risk Friday
item.description: Severe thunderstorms with hail and a limited risk of tornadoes are possible in the evening, with showers and thunderstorms gradually exiting by morning and warm, windy weather returning Monday ahead of another wave of stormy weather Tuesday into Tuesday night.

item.title: Birthplace of Route 66 Festival reveals 2026 lineup, car show details
item.description: The 2026 Birthplace of Route 66 Festival in Springfield, MO will feature a downtown car show, free concerts, a cruise-in, and appearances by Dave Kindig and Kevin Schiele, as well as an Authors, Artists, Collectors & Associations expo.
